messages:
jessica: Hey folks — clearing out some office surplus. I have an LG 27" 4K monitor (model `27UP83W`) in great shape, used ~6 months, no dead pixels. Also an IKEA Bekant sit/stand desk (48x30) with a small nick on the edge. Free for pickup at the SF office Mon (10:00-14:00) or Tue (13:00-17:00). DM me to claim. :slightly_smiling_face:

omar: Interested in the monitor. Any scratches on the bezel or stand? Does it include the power cable and HDMI/USB-C?

jessica: No scratches on the panel, tiny scuff on the plastic bezel near the back but not visible front-on. Comes with power cable + USB-C (no thunderbolt). Stand is the original, height tilt.

kelly: Also curious about desk height range? Is it electric or crank?

jessica: Electric motor works fine, height range ~65-125 cm. I can bring the wrench/assembly bits. FYI I can only help carry from parking to office lobby, need someone strong to move it into your car. :sweat_smile:

alex: Can you ship if I cover costs? I'm remote in Oakland.

jessica: I can ship the monitor if you cover postage + packaging. Desk is heavy so pickup only unless you want to arrange freight.

ryan: I can pick up Tue 2pm if no one else claims. Ryan here.

jessica: @ryan noted — please DM me to confirm and I'll hold for 24 hours.

michael-facilities-bot: Reminder: please reserve a loading dock slot for furniture pick-up via the facilities calendar (https://company-calendar.local/facilities).

omar: If Ryan flakes, I'm next in line. Also will bring a blanket for the desk. :thumbsup:

kelly: If the monitor's still around after Ryan, I can take it — need an extra screen for the home office.

jessica: Cool — tentatively held for Ryan until 1719427000 (24h). If he doesn't confirm by then I'll DM next in line. Thanks y'all! :sparkles:

alex: Thanks for doing this. Beats dropping it off at recycling. :recycle:

ryan: Confirmed — I'll DM now and can pick up Tue 14:00. Appreciate it!

jessica: Awesome, see you Tue. Please bring a box if you're shipping the monitor, otherwise I'll have it unplugged and boxed in the office. 

omar: glhf moving day. :muscle:

kelly: (saves a reminder to check in case it gets released again)
